notablePrerequisites:
You control an artifact creature with mana value at least five.
Slobad and Scarecrone do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature with mana value five or greater, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate artifact abilities.
Activate Scarecrone's last ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
